channel.desc: The Christian enjoys the beauty of nature with the highest appreciation, for he recognizes his Father's handiwork (SC, 87). The Christian confirms when under pressure whom he serves, for what we have absorbed is what we will release, (J. Reish). The Lord's love is evidenced in His creation, the devil's work in its decay. Who are we letting in ? What are we letting out ?
